claim: Osteria Francescana is a Three Stars Michelin restaurant in Modena in the 2026 Guida Italia, led by Massimo Bottura.
quote: Osteria Francescana confirms its Three Stars as 'worth a special journey' in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia.

claim: The Italy 2026 list of Three-Star restaurants for Emilia-Romagna includes only Osteria Francescana; no new 3-star was added in the region.
quote: Two restaurants newly awarded Two MICHELIN Stars in Italy 2026; the new 3-Star is in Piedmont, not Emilia-Romagna.

claim: Osteria Francescana sits at Via Stella 22, 41121 Modena; reservations are online-only with a €300/person credit-card hold released after the visit and a 96-hour cancellation window.
quote: Address: Via Stella, 22 · 41121 Modena. €300 per person hold 4 days prior to arrival; free cancellation up to 96 hours in advance.

claim: Osteria Francescana's 2026 tasting menu 'Ho Fame! Ho Fame!' is 11 courses at €350, with seven-wine pairing at €240.
quote: An 11-course tasting menu for 350 euros. The wine pairing is 240 euros for seven wines.

claim: Bottura's current Francescana tasting menu is themed 'Ho Fame! Ho Fame!' inspired by a Vincenzo Cabiati ceramic.
quote: The current tasting menu is called 'Ho Fame! Ho Fame!' inspired by a ceramic artwork by Vincenzo Cabiati.

claim: San Domenico in Imola is a 2-star Michelin restaurant in 2026 with cuisine by chef Massimiliano Mascia.
quote: San Domenico is a Two Stars: Excellent cooking restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia, with Massimiliano Mascia's cuisine.

claim: San Domenico earned its first Michelin star in 1975 and its second in 1977, making it Italy's longest-standing 2-star restaurant.
quote: First Michelin star in 1975, second star two years later; Italy's longest-standing 2-star restaurant.

claim: Imola is roughly 96 km by road from Modena (about a 1-hour drive via A1/A14).
quote: The driving distance from Modena to Imola is about 96 kilometers.

claim: Magnolia in Longiano (FC) is a 2-star Michelin restaurant under chef Alberto Faccani, set in Relais Villa Margherita.
quote: Magnolia in Longiano holds 2 Michelin stars under chef Alberto Faccani in the 2026 Guide.

claim: Magnolia relocated from Cesenatico to a Longiano villa in 2017 while retaining its Michelin trajectory.
quote: In 2017, Magnolia moved to Longiano to a new location, relocating from its original location in Cesenatico.

claim: Al Gatto Verde at Casa Maria Luigia is a 1-star Michelin restaurant in 2026 and also holds a Michelin Green Star for sustainability.
quote: Al Gatto Verde is a One Star restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia, with a Green Star for sustainability.

claim: Al Gatto Verde, chef Jessica Rosval, sits at Stradello Bonaghino 56 in San Damaso (Modena) inside Casa Maria Luigia, with wood-fired Emilian cuisine; booking is via the Casa Maria Luigia room/dining system.
quote: Stradello Bonaghino 56, San Damaso/Modena, Italy; wood-fired cuisine, Emilian flavours; booking through Casa Maria Luigia's reservation system.

claim: Cavallino in Maranello earned its first Michelin star in the 2026 Guide, awarded November 2025 under chefs Riccardo Forapani and Virginia Cattaneo with creative direction from Massimo Bottura.
quote: Cavallino is a One Star restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia under chefs Riccardo Forapani and Virginia Cattaneo, with Bottura's creative vision.

claim: Cavallino sits across from the Ferrari factory in Maranello, in the farmhouse Enzo Ferrari used as his daily lunch spot, reopened in 2021 in collaboration with Bottura.
quote: The restaurant is located in the rooms of an old farmhouse that Enzo Ferrari purchased.

claim: Cavallino's set menus include 'Welcome to Emilia' (from €65 + €38 wine pairing) and the longer 'Supercars / Gran Turismo' developed with Ferrari Styling Centre.
quote: Welcome to Emilia menu, starting at €65 per person with wine pairing for €38; Gran Turismo experience as the longer option.

claim: L'Erba del Re is a 1-star Michelin restaurant in Modena's centre in 2026, led by chef Luca Marchini.
quote: L'Erba del Re is a One Star restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia.

claim: L'Erba del Re is at Via Castel Maraldo 45, Modena, holding its Michelin star since 2008 with chef-patron Luca Marchini; the cellar carries 700+ labels.
quote: Via Castel Maraldo, 45, 41121 Modena. Holding the Michelin star since 2008.

claim: Arnaldo Clinica Gastronomica in Rubiera lost its Michelin star in the 2026 Guide after holding it continuously since 1959 — the longest-standing star in Italy.
quote: Arnaldo perde la stella Michelin: l'aveva dal 1959.

claim: Driving from Bologna, Modena is about 30 min by train / 45 min by car, and Imola is about 30 min by train / 40 min by car — making San Domenico reachable from a Modena base.
quote: Modena: 45 min by car / 30 min by train from Bologna. Imola: 40 min by car / 30 min by train from Bologna.

claim: Bottura took on Cavallino in 2021, framing it as Modena's 'slow food and fast cars' fusion.
quote: I'm from the land of slow food and fast cars — Bottura on taking on Ristorante Cavallino.
